(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing does not state whether this size is before or after the I.Z.B.P. plating. Plating buildup will reduce the hole diameter and can cause the mating shaft to no longer fit; the designer should add a note specifying that the H7 dimension applies after plating, or adjust the pre-plate machining size to allow for coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'H7 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or specify an oversize pre-plate bore dimension that accounts for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
